notes: Public displays of affection relate to purity norms around modesty and decency in public behavior.
Gentleness is a core care foundation virtue; harshness is its opposite.
Heartfelt pole relates to empathy and warmth, core care foundation traits.
Seemly/inappropriate relate to decency (purity), social norms and propriety (authority), and general moral conduct.
Fake pole relates to dishonesty (fairness); authenticity vs. deception also carries general moral valence.

Divine pole relates to purity foundation's sacred/spiritual dimension and striving toward an elevated, less carnal existence.
